name: salon-hub
description: Monorepo for salon-hub backend (apps/api) and frontend (apps/web).

scripts.build: npm run api:build && npm run web:build
scripts.test: npm run api:test && npm run web:test
scripts.ci: npm run web:install && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.verify:web: npm run web:lint && npm run web:test && npm run web:build
